name: CFS (IS 801) + IS 800 braced frames
blurb: Cold-formed steel to IS 801:1975 (working stress, IS 811 sections) for studs, tracks, joists, purlins and girts, with the lateral system as hot-rolled IS 800 Section 12 braced frames (OCBF in Zone II, SCBF/EBF in Zones III–V) or SMF portals; one all-CFS elastic portal (R = 1.0). Loads to IS 875 (Parts 1–5), seismic to IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 + Amd 1/2.

tabs.title: Design
tabs.blurb: Paste a brief and the agent writes cfg.py (units N, mm, MPa; kN/m² for area loads), retrieves the loads live from IS 875 / IS 1893 into load_plan.json, runs the engine, fills design/calc_package_cfs.json (design_status COMPLETE / INCOMPLETE with reasons) and delivers report.html + viewer_3d.html + STATUS.md + EOR_inputs.json. CFS members are designed to IS 801 working stress (F = 0.60 Fy; +33⅓ % only for combinations with wind or earthquake); the braced frames to IS 800 Section 12. A new run on a project that already holds a design archives the old one beside it (<project>__<timestamp>). Clauses are retrieved from the IS corpus on this PC (the IS corpus module) — without it the agent cites the standards from memory and flags every value to verify.

fields.label: Design brief
fields.placeholder:
4-storey residential, IS 801 CFS stud walls and joists, plan 12 m × 30 m, storeys 3.0 m.
Lateral: hot-rolled IS 800 SCBF (IS 808 sections) in both directions. Floor dead 2.0 kN/m² / imposed 2.0 kN/m²; roof dead 1.5 / imposed 0.75 kN/m².
Site: New Delhi — IS 1893 Zone IV, soil Type II, residential (I = 1.0). Wind: IS 875-3 Vb 47 m/s, terrain category 3. Steel IS 2062 E250; CFS Fy 240 MPa.
fields.help: Storeys, bays and spacings (m), loads (kN/m²), site (IS 1893 zone / Annex E town, soil type, occupancy for I; IS 875-3 Vb or Annex A town, terrain category, cyclone belt), lateral system and R, steel grades (IS 2062 for the frames, Fy for the CFS members).

fields.label: Analysis fidelity
fields.help: How faithfully the analysis model captures thin-wall section softening (stiffness only — strength checks are always the full IS 801 set). Auto lets the agent pick the tier for your structure; the preflight check warns if a chosen tier looks wrong for it.

options.label: Auto (recommended)
Tier 0 — Standard (stud-wall buildings on IS 800 braced frames)
Tier 1 — Thin-walled members (portals, canopies)
Tier 2 — High fidelity (slender/torsion-critical)

fields.label: Upload files
fields.help: Text / Markdown is read into the brief; a text-based PDF has its text extracted into the brief (scanned pages have no text layer); images are attached as references and sent to the model — the design agent uses the first three, and not every LLM can read images.

links.label: Download package (.zip)

tabs.title: Continue
tabs.blurb: Resume a paused or stopped design, or iterate on a finished one with new instructions. The agent keeps its full conversation, so a follow-up like “use 1.6 mm lipped-channel studs (IS 811) at 400 mm and rerun” continues THIS design.

fields.label: Follow-up instructions (optional)
